effect.ZERO_FLUX_ALWAYS_ON: Allows the zero-flux speed boost to take effect regardless of flux level.
effect.SHIP_RECOVERY_CHANCE_BONUS: If disabled, this ship is almost always recoverable after the battle.
stat.armorDamageTakenPerDMod: armor damage taken per D-mod, up to 5 D-mods
effect.PD_IGNORES_DECOY_FLARES: Point-defense weapons can identify and ignore decoy flares.
effect.PD_BEST_TARGET_LEADING: Point-defense weapons get the best possible target leading, regardless of combat readiness.
effect.PD_RECLASSIFY_SMALL_WEAPONS: All small non-missile, non-strike weapons are classified as point-defense, automatically target missiles, and are affected by point-defense stat modifiers.
stat.commandPointRecoveryWhileFlagship: command point recovery rate while this ship is the flagship
stat.fluxRateOfFireAndAmmoRegenWhilePhas: flux dissipation, weapon rate of fire, and ammo regeneration while phased
effect.PHASE_ANCHOR_EMERGENCY_DIVE: While at risk of being destroyed or disabled, this ship can instead perform an emergency dive into phase space, retreating from battle and suffering an additional combat readiness penalty equal to {value}% of its deployment cost. The ship must have enough combat readiness to cover this cost. Only one ship per battle, regardless of side, can perform this dive.
effect.BEAM_WEAPON_SPLIT_TARGETS_FLAT.on: Beam weapon hits split their damage evenly across the target and up to {value} additional nearby enemy. The target acquisition range is half the beam weapon's range. Split beams also carry the weapon's special beam effects.
effect.BEAM_WEAPON_SPLIT_TARGETS_FLAT.ot: Beam weapon hits split their damage evenly across the target and up to {value} additional nearby enemies. The target acquisition range is half the beam weapon's range. Split beams also carry the weapon's special beam effects.
effect.EXPLODE_ON_DEATH: When this ship is destroyed, it detonates violently, dealing high-explosive damage equal to up to {value}% of its maximum fuel capacity to nearby ships, tapering off with distance.
effect.NON_BEAM_ENERGY_WEAPON_CHAIN_CHAN: Non-beam energy weapon hits that land on an enemy shield have a {value}% chance to chain to a nearby enemy ship. The chaining projectile has an equal chance to chain again, as long as it hits a shield.
effect.NON_BEAM_ENERGY_WEAPON_CHAIN_FALL: Each successive hit in a non-beam energy chain deals <bad>{value}%</bad> less damage than the one before it.
effect.ESCORT_MANEUVER_BONUS_PERCENT: While within range of a larger friendly ship, increases maneuverability (acceleration, deceleration, and turn rate) by up to {value}%, fading with distance. Doubled for a destroyer escorting a capital ship.
effect.ESCORT_SPEED_BONUS_PERCENT: While within range of a larger friendly ship, increases top speed by up to {value}%, fading with distance. Doubled for a destroyer escorting a capital ship.
effect.ESCORT_WEAPON_RANGE_BONUS_PERCENT: While within range of a larger friendly ship, increases ballistic and energy weapon range by up to {value}%, fading with distance. Doubled for a destroyer escorting a capital ship.
effect.ESCORT_PROXIMITY_RANGE_FLAT: The escort bonuses above apply at full strength within {value} su of the larger friendly ship, fading out over an additional 500 su beyond that.
effect.NANOFORGE_HULL_REGEN_PERCENT: After {seconds} seconds without taking hull damage, repairs {value}% of maximum hull per second in combat, up to {limit}% of maximum hull in total per deployment.
effect.DISINTEGRATION_ARMOR_DAMAGE_PERCE: Energy weapon hits on armor strip an additional {value}% of the hit's damage from the armor around the impact. This extra damage never reaches the hull.
effect.TERRIFYING_PRESENCE_ACCURACY_PENA: Enemy ships within {range} su have the target leading accuracy of their autofiring weapons reduced by <good>{value}%</good>.
effect.NON_BEAM_WEAPON_DAMAGE_PER_SPEED_: Increases ballistic and non-beam energy weapon damage by <good>{value}%</good> for every su/s of the ship's current speed, with no cap.
effect.MEDIUM_ENERGY_SLOT_WEAPON_RANGE_F: Increases the base range of weapons in medium energy slots by <good>{value}</good>.
effect.SHIELD_ABSORB_RATE_OF_FIRE_PERCEN: Flux taken by the shield charges a reserve of up to {max}, which drains by {drain} per second. While charged, ballistic and energy weapon rate of fire increases by up to <good>{value}%</good>, at full strength from {full} reserve, and non-beam weapons pay less flux per shot so their faster fire costs no extra flux.
effect.HEARTLESS_ON_NEARBY_DESTRUCTION_R: Whenever a non-fighter ship is destroyed within {value} su, this ship gains a Heartless stack until the end of combat. By default, ships can hold a maximum of {stacks} Heartless stacks.
effect.HEARTLESS_ARMOR_RESTORE_PERCENT: Gaining a Heartless stack restores <good>{value}%</good> of maximum armor to every armor cell.
effect.HEARTLESS_ARMOR_PERCENT_PER_STACK: Each Heartless stack increases the maximum armor of every cell by <good>{value}%</good>.
effect.HEARTLESS_MOBILITY_PENALTY_PERCEN: Each Heartless stack reduces top speed and maneuverability by <bad>{value}%</bad>.
effect.HEARTLESS_RADIATION_EMP_FLAT: Each new Heartless stack sets off a radiation surge that deals <bad>{value}</bad> EMP damage to a random weapon and to a random engine on this ship.
effect.HEARTLESS_CREW_DEATH_CHANCE_PERCE: Each Heartless stack adds a <bad>{value}%</bad> chance for a crew member to die per missile fired. All must serve.
effect.HEARTLESS_MISSILE_DAMAGE_PERCENT_: Each Heartless stack increases missile damage by <good>{value}%</good> while the fleet has crew left to give.
effect.HEARTLESS_MISSILE_SPEED_PERCENT_P: Each Heartless stack increases missile top speed by <good>{value}%</good> while the fleet has crew left to give.
effect.FLUX_SCALED_TOP_SPEED_FLAT: Top speed changes with flux, from <good>+{value}</good> su/s at no flux to <bad>-{value}</bad> su/s at full flux, with no change at half flux. Below half flux, acceleration and turn acceleration also rise by up to <good>{value}%</good>.
effect.FLUX_SCALED_RATE_OF_FIRE_PERCENT: Weapon rate of fire changes with flux, from <good>+{value}%</good> at no flux to <bad>-{value}%</bad> at full flux, with no change at half flux. Venting or being overloaded counts as full flux.
effect.FLUX_CAPACITOR_EFFECTIVENESS_PERC: Each flux capacitor grants <good>{value}%</good> more flux capacity.
effect.AUGMENTED_FLUX_SCALED_PENALTY_RED: On hulls with Augmented Systems, the high-flux top speed and rate of fire penalties are <good>{value}%</good> smaller.
effect.AUGMENTED_INERTIAL_PROJECTILE_SPE: On hulls with Augmented Systems, projectile speed also rises by <good>{value}%</good> of the speed-based damage bonus.
effect.AUGMENTED_SYSTEM_REGEN_PERCENT: On hulls with Augmented Systems, ship system charges regenerate <good>{value}%</good> faster.
effect.FIGHTER_BAYS_FLAT.warning: Cannot be unallocated without at least 1 empty fighter bay.
effect.FIGHTER_REPLACEMENT_RATE_MULT.slo: <bad>{value}%</bad> slower fighter replacement rate decay and recovery.
effect.FIGHTER_REPLACEMENT_RATE_MULT.fas: <good>{value}%</good> faster fighter replacement rate decay and recovery.
effect.BEAM_WEAPON_HARD_FLUX_PERCENT: Causes {value}% of beam weapon damage dealt to shields to be hard flux.
effect.SHIELD_DAMAGE_SHARED_PERCENT: Disperses {value}% of shield damage taken to nearby allied ships within {range} su that aren't overloaded or venting, split evenly between them as hard flux.
effect.PHASE_FIELD_CONTRIBUTION_PERCENT: Even if this ship isn't a phase ship, {value}% of its sensor strength counts toward the fleet-wide detected-at range reduction that phase ships normally provide (see the Phase Field hull mod) - the more (and stronger-sensor) ships contribute, the less visible the fleet becomes, with diminishing returns. Only applies while the fleet's transponder is off.
stat.weaponDamagePerDMod: weapon damage per D-mod, up to 5 D-mods
effect.GROUND_SUPPORT_PER_MAX_CREW_PERCE: Increases the effective strength of planetary raids by <good>{value}%</good> of this ship's maximum crew capacity (after modifiers), up to the total number of marines in the fleet.
effect.BALLISTIC_WEAPON_DAMAGE_PER_BURN_: Grants <good>{value}%</good> more ballistic weapon damage for every burn level this ship has above its hull's default, from any source.
effect.ENERGY_WEAPON_RANGE_PER_SENSOR_ST: Increases energy weapon range by <good>{value}</good> for every point of this ship's sensor strength (after modifiers).
effect.ARMOR_FLAT_FOR_LOW_BASE_ARMOR: Increases armor by up to <good>{most}</good>. Hulls with less base armor gain more: the bonus falls to <good>{least}</good> at <hl>{cutoff}</hl> base armor (frigate/destroyer/cruiser/capital ship). Can't be allocated on phase ships or on hulls with more base armor than that.

effect.CREATE_FRONT_SHIELD_IF_NONE: Installs a makeshift, front-facing shield if this ship has none.

effect.CONVERT_SHIELD_TO_OMNI: Converts this ship's shield to omni-directional.
effect.DEATH_ON_COLLISION: Any collision, however slight, is instantly fatal to this ship.

ui.template.hint.saveEmpty: Allocate at least one node before saving a template.
ui.template.hint.load: Choose a saved template for this ship. Its path is shown in green. Nothing is allocated until you allocate it yourself or use Auto-allocate.

ui.template.hint.autoNoPoints: No ordnance points or free allocations are left.

settings.language.name: Language
settings.language.tooltip: Language for Exiled Sector's text. Auto follows the game's language. Takes effect after restarting the game. Text the game draws itself, such as these settings, dialogs and the codex, stays in English unless the game can display Chinese characters.
settings.about: Gives each ship its own skill tree. Open a ship's refit screen and use the Skill Tree button to allocate nodes.
settings.opCost.about: How many ordnance points each allocated skill node costs, by hull size.
settings.opCost.other: Other Hull Sizes OP per Node
settings.level.about: Ships gain XP from combat, scaled by the deployment points of enemy ships destroyed in that battle and boosted by vanilla's battle difficulty rating, and level up. Each level converts the ship's most recently OP-purchased node into a free one (or banks the free allocation for the next node allocated, if there's nothing eligible to convert).
settings.level.xpGrowth.name: XP Growth per Level
settings.level.xpGrowth.tooltip: How much harder each level is to reach than the last.
settings.level.xpGrowthCutoff.name: XP Growth Cutoff Level
settings.level.xpGrowthCutoff.tooltip: The level at which the exponential XP curve stops compounding. From this level onward, every level costs the same XP as the level just before the cutoff did (e.g. a cutoff of 30 makes every level from 30 on cost the same as level 29 to 30).
settings.level.xpPerDeploymentPoint: XP per Enemy Deployment Point Destroyed
settings.level.xpDifficultyStrength.name: XP Bonus from Battle Difficulty
settings.level.xpDifficultyStrength.tool: Scales how much of vanilla's pre-battle difficulty bonus (Additional XP due to overall battle difficulty) applies to ship XP. 1 matches vanilla, 0 turns it off. Easier battles never reduce XP.
settings.level.xpDifficultyMaxMultiplier: Max XP Multiplier from Battle Difficulty
Upper limit on the XP multiplier from battle difficulty. Vanilla caps its own at 6x.
settings.level.maxAllocatedNodes.name: Max Allocated Nodes
settings.level.maxAllocatedNodes.tooltip: Maximum number of nodes a ship can have allocated at once, free or not.
settings.hiddenNodes.about: Nodes with an unmet unlock condition normally render as unidentified, blinking sensor ghosts.
settings.hiddenNodes.show.name: Show Hidden Nodes by Default
settings.hiddenNodes.show.tooltip: Reveals the true appearance and tooltip of locked nodes instead of hiding them as sensor ghosts. Purely visual - locked nodes still cannot be allocated.
settings.unlock.about: Each toggle treats every unlock condition of that type as already met, letting nodes gated only by it be allocated. This does not grant hullmods, change game state, or affect anything else - allocation still requires the node's connected-node prerequisites to be satisfied.
settings.unlock.minShipLevel: Disable Minimum Ship Level Unlock Conditions
settings.energyChain.maxChainCount.name: Max Chain Count
settings.energyChain.maxChainCount.toolt: Safety limit on how many links a single non-beam energy chain can have, independent of chance rolls succeeding. Not intended as a balance knob.
settings.npc.about: Some ships in NPC fleets get their own skill tree so they keep up with your fleet. This covers every faction, including your own faction's fleets and your allies. A chosen ship follows one of the NPC build layouts and gets the free root node plus a number of nodes rolled from the table below for your character level. If the ship strips a hullmod to take its matching node, the OP that hullmod used buys extra nodes at the normal per-node OP cost.
settings.npc.enabled.name: Enable NPC Skill Trees
settings.npc.enabled.tooltip: When off, no NPC ship gets a skill tree.
settings.npc.officeredShips.name: Always Level Officered Ships
settings.npc.officeredShips.tooltip: Every NPC ship captained by an officer gets a skill tree.
settings.npc.flagship.name: Always Level the Flagship
settings.npc.flagship.tooltip: Every NPC fleet's flagship gets a skill tree.
settings.npc.otherShipChance.name: Chance for Other Ships
settings.npc.otherShipChance.tooltip: Percent chance that each remaining combat ship in an NPC fleet gets a skill tree.
settings.npc.inspectKey.name: Inspect NPC Skill Trees Key
settings.npc.inspectKey.tooltip: In a fleet encounter, or while hovering another fleet on the map, press this key to list its ships that have skill trees and their bonuses.
settings.npcNodes.about: Each levelled NPC ship rolls its node count between the minimum and maximum for your current character level, on top of its free root node. If a minimum is set above its maximum, the two are swapped.
settings.npcNodes.min.name: Minimum Nodes
settings.npcNodes.min.tooltip: Fewest nodes a levelled NPC ship gets at player level {level}.
settings.npcNodes.min.tooltipAndAbove: Fewest nodes a levelled NPC ship gets at player level {level} and above.
settings.npcNodes.max.name: Maximum Nodes
settings.npcNodes.max.tooltip: Most nodes a levelled NPC ship gets at player level {level}.
settings.npcNodes.max.tooltipAndAbove: Most nodes a levelled NPC ship gets at player level {level} and above.
